source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ካልአ፡ መባርቅተ፡ ወከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ ከመ፡ ይጼውዖሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ በበአስማቲሆሙ፡ ወይሰምዕዎ።
source.note: Charles 1906 selected edited Geʽez, PDF122 printed84. Arabic raised apparatus numerals are not body text. Final source includes the object him in ወይሰምዕዎ. Medium bounded author assessment after disclosed source-only control and renewed native inspection; no manuscript or autograph certification.

translation.text: And I saw other flashes of lightning and the stars of heaven, and I saw that he calls them all by their respective names, and they hear him.

source.text: ወርኢክዎ፡ ለመድለወ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ከመ፡ ይደለዉ፡ በብርሃናቲሆሙ፡ በርኅበ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወ*ዕለተ፡ ኩነቶሙ፡ ወሚጠቶሙ፡ መብረቅ፡ ይወልድ፡ ወሚጠቶሙ፡ በ*ኅልቈ፡ መላእክት፡ ወሃይማኖቶሙ፡ የዓቅቡ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ።
source.note: Charles 1906 selected edited Geʽez, PDF122 printed84. Provisional whole-unit transcription and English only. Editorial stars preserved; unresolved true fidels/vowel orders and lexical/attachment issues require hold, not caveat-based acceptance.
transcription_uncertainties: Exact weighing-verb vowel order remains unresolved: provisional ይደለዉ versus source-control ይደለው.
Breadth/extent word provisionally በርኅበ; source control reads ሰረኃበ.
Starred word after ወ now provisionally ዕለተ, not my earlier ስልተ; exact true fidels and the day/ordering interpretation still require resolution.
Initial vowel order of being/status noun provisionally ኩነቶሙ versus source-control ክነቶሙ; count-form ኅልቈ versus source-control ኍልቈ also not securely resolved.
Attachment and exact lexical force of the weighing/list/day-being clauses remain uncertain.

translation.text: And I saw it for a just weighing: how they are weighed according to their brightnesses, the breadth of their places, and the day of their being.[a] Their course brings forth lightning, and their course is according to the number of angels; and they keep their faithfulness to one another.[b]

footnotes.text: The wording about weighing, extent, and the day of their being is provisional. Several true-fidel/vowel-order readings and clause attachments remain unresolved; this entire unit is held, not approved with a caveat.

The selected print has editorial asterisks at the provisional day-word and number-word. The stars are retained in the source transcription, but the exact readings in this held unit still require resolution; no alternate witness or translation has been substituted.

source.text: ወተስእልክዎ፡ ለመልአክ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ምስሌየ፡ ዘአርአየኒ፡ ዘኅቡአ፡ ምንት፡ *እሙንቱ፡ እሉ።
source.note: Charles 1906 selected edited Geʽez, PDF122 printed84. The source retains the opening object him, the two angel-relative clauses, hidden-thing wording ዘኅቡአ, and starred plural *እሙንቱ. Actual Dillmann pp599 photograph col600 explicitly cites Hen43,3 for the hidden-word. Medium bounded author assessment after disclosed controls; no manuscript certification.

translation.text: And I asked him, the angel who was walking with me and who had shown me what was hidden, “What are these?[a]”

footnotes.text: The selected edited text places an editorial asterisk before the plural “they are” in the question. The printed plural is retained; the asterisk is an edition-level critical sign, not a certification of individual manuscript witnesses.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ አርአየከ፡ እሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ አስማቲሆሙ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወየአምኑ፡ በስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።

translation.text: And he said to me, “The Lord of spirits has shown you their likeness.[a] These are the names of the holy ones who dwell on dry land and believe in the name of the Lord of spirits forever and ever.”

footnotes.text: The possessive phrase is provisionally rendered “their likeness,” not an added act of sowing. This entire unit remains held because exact source fidels/vowel orders are not yet securely resolved; this note is not approval to publish it.
